mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1800K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1800K units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, stimulating equity markets and yielding positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 3.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) shows a concurrent 3-month average increase of over 200K jobs, the combined signal of a tight labor market and strong job growth predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and equity performance
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60d are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.1) in triggered instances compared to non-triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over a 2-month period, indicating a supply-side boost, is expected to lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, especially during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows no significant positive return difference (p > 0.05) in triggered vs. non-triggered periods over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth exceeding 3% on a quarterly annualized basis, signaling strong aggregate demand, is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, with increased confidence during early-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: Triggered instances do not outperform (t-test p > 0.05) non-triggered periods over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Whenever the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is hiked by more than 50 basis points within a month, the sudden tightening predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as markets adjust to decreased liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX shows positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a single month, coupled with a decrease in payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the same period, jointly signal labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market shocks and equity responses
failure_condition: Triggered instances do not underperform (t-test p > 0.1) non-triggered periods over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail and food services sales (RSAFS) increasing by more than 5% on a year-over-year basis, indicating strong consumer spending, is predictive of positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, particularly in late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis fails to show a significant positive return difference (p > 0.05) in triggered vs. non-triggered periods over a 3-year window.
